about.label: About Seven Seas
about.heading: Building Responsible Pathways from Nepal to Global Employment.
about.description: Seven Seas Intercontinental is a Nepal-based international recruitment company that connects global employers with trained, screened, and deployment-ready Nepali workforce. Our services cover the complete recruitment cycle — from employer workforce sourcing and candidate identification to screening, trade testing, practical training, documentation support, and deployment coordination.

impact.heading: Our Reach & Impact
impact.note: Statistics managed through the admin panel. Unverified numbers are not displayed.

solutions.heading: Workforce Solutions
solutions.subheading: A structured approach to international recruitment and workforce deployment.
solutions.candidateSourcingDesc: Identification and pre-screening of qualified candidates from across Nepal through our network of verified sourcing channels.
solutions.candidateScreeningDesc: Comprehensive background verification, document authentication, and skills assessment to ensure candidate readiness.
solutions.tradeTestingDesc: Practical skill evaluation at our trade test centres to verify hands-on capabilities against employer requirements.
solutions.trainingOrientationDesc: Pre-departure orientation, language training, cultural preparation, and industry-specific skill development.
solutions.documentationDesc: End-to-end support for employment contracts, visa processing, medical examinations, and government clearance.
solutions.deploymentDesc: Travel coordination, airport assistance, and post-deployment follow-up to ensure smooth workforce integration.

training.heading: Prepared Before Deployment.

trust.heading: Trust Is Documented.
